inputs.text: [excited] Uh… MAR… guh… SOR… us. [curious] Two pieces in this name. [pauses] "Amarga" is a place: La Amarga, in Argentina, where its bones were found.
[warmly] The whole name, yes. It lived in Argentina, [amazed] a hundred twenty-five million years ago, [pauses] with two rows of really big spikes on its neck and back.
